verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an official CLI: a probe confirms first-party CLI docs, the homepage shows `npx auth init`, and the device-authorization docs refer to "the Better Auth CLI". Community users independently report using it to generate database tables and migrations. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the CLI command set and flags, evidence of AI/agent-oriented features (machine-readable output, non-interactive agent use)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI
You get all of your auth data in your own db in 1 cli command.
migration was easy using the CLI to generate tables
